cards.card_text: Herod the tetrarch, a ruler in the land, hears the reports about Jesus.
cards.verse_text: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus
cards.snippet: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus

cards.card_text: It's the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, the Roman emperor, with Pontius Pilate governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee (not the King Herod from when Jesus was born), and Annas and Caiaphas as high priests.
cards.verse_text: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene, during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.
cards.snippet: …reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias…

cards.card_text: But he also rebukes Herod the tetrarch about Herodias, his brother's wife, and all the evils Herod had done.
cards.verse_text: But when he rebuked Herod the tetrarch regarding his brother’s wife Herodias and all the evils he had done,
cards.snippet: But when he rebuked Herod the tetrarch regarding his brother’s wife Herodias and all the evils he had done,

cards.card_text: Word of all that's happening reaches Herod the tetrarch, the ruler of Galilee (Luke 3:1), the man who locked John the Baptist in prison (Luke 3:19-20).
cards.verse_text: When Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening, he was perplexed.
cards.snippet: When Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening, he was perplexed.

cards.card_text: Manaen, one of the prophets and teachers at Antioch, had been brought up with ___ the tetrarch.
cards.verse_text: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch), and Saul.
cards.snippet: …Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch), and Saul.
